propositions: LLMRunnerError raised on step-budget exhaustion does not match the UnretryableOutputError catch clause in CompletionAgentStep.run, preventing bounded recovery from engaging
Bounded per-criterion recovery mechanism (which isolates each criterion in fresh agentic history and converges evidence to 16 steps) is unreachable for budget exhaustion errors due to type mismatch
A new typed exception LLMBudgetExhaustedError must be created as a subclass of LLMRunnerError to enable type-safe identification of budget exhaustion without diagnostic shape sniffing
The except clause in CompletionAgentStep.run must be extended to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to the existing _recover method while preserving the original diagnostic

Budget exhaustion must become identifiable purely by exception type rather than message or diagnostic key patterns, since interpret_failure attaches identical diagnostic structures to all exception types it raises
